audit: Fresh public-source search for Fang 2011 ROCK-II inhibitor article

primary.title: Synthesis and biological evaluation of 4-quinazolinones as Rho kinase inhibitors
primary.citation: Fang X et al., Bioorg Med Chem Lett 21(6):1844-1848 (2011)

new_public_sources_checked.result: The author profile lists the Fang 2011 article and a public Download link, but the linked attachment is protected by a Cloudflare challenge and was not retrieved.
Record provides citation and abstract but explicitly shows no full-text PDF available; it offers a request-to-author flow, which was not used.
Index links PMID 21349713 to 35 BindingDB entries and 2D/3D/TSV views. This is a curated secondary data source, not the primary article/SI, and does not establish assay construct or ATP conditions.

access_gap.reason: Publisher download remains restricted; author-profile attachment is Cloudflare-protected; ResearchGate has no full text; no unauthenticated author/repository copy exposing the primary tables was found.

primary_method_and_mapping.readout: ChEMBL/BindingDB secondary annotations say HTRF, but this was not verified against the primary method section.
primary_method_and_mapping.status: unresolved; no new primary evidence obtained

eligibility.reason: The required primary assay protocol and structure-linked table cannot be verified from the newly checked public sources.
eligibility.safe_conclusion: Retain the prior Phase 19 access gap. Do not promote the 35 secondary records to a primary independent benchmark or infer construct/ATP conditions from database labels.

sources_not_retrieved: No article PDF or SI was downloaded in Phase 20, so no source hash is claimed.
